title: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.CondensedRing.isIso_boundedConstructibleBaseChange_of_isProper_padicAlgCl
statement: For a prime ℓ and separated finite-type schemes X,Y,X′,Y′ over a field k of positive prime characteristic different from ℓ, let f,g,f′,g′ be k-morphisms forming a cartesian square with f proper. The bounded constructible pro-étale base-change natural transformation with coefficients in Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj ℓ, whose sections are continuous maps into finite subextensions of Q̄_ℓ, is an isomorphism of functors.
